title: AuthorizationFinalizationEvidence v0.2 — NOT_REQUIRED transaction component (draft/non-default)
description: Selected ASSERT_OPERATION_CLAIM component only. Record syntax does not prove authority, domain validation, clock trust, guards, atomic commit or release closure. Caller projection is auxiliary, never a root evidence record.

canonicalUtcMicros.$comment: PR #23 section 6.3 spelling, with PR #38 whole-microsecond support. Unsupported required precision refuses this attempt; no rounding.

canonicalUtc.$comment: PR #23 canonical UTC spelling for later owner observations. Their own admissibility is not supplied by this schema.

callerSubmissionProjection.$comment: PR #26 section 5.3: preserve every callerEffectIntent member. This auxiliary object is not a root evidence record or domain validation.

checkpoint.$comment: Original attempt context and checkpoint must match across consumption, attempt and receipt. Full D is owned by the evaluator. No physical commit/consumption timestamp exists in this branch.

modeEvidence.$comment: Closed branch is the absence posture. No approval/reservation/direct-human-finalization field is allowed. This record is not authority.

reconciliationEvidence.$comment: Quarantine is the existing derived invariant-breach posture, not a fourth transaction outcome. NO_EFFECT plus unresolvedFacts preserves proven rollback while separate evidence-commit status remains unknown.
